excerpts:
The event returns to the Empire Polo Club in California next April By Eric Torres April 22, 2024 2024 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival (Dania Maxwell / Los Angeles Times via Getty Images) Save this story Save this story The Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival has announced the dates for its 2025 edition. The festival will return to the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, for the weekends of April 11-13 and April 18-20. Advance ticket sales will begin next Friday, May 3. This year’s Coachella, which took place during the weekends of April 12-14 and April 19-21, featured headliners Lana Del Rey , Tyler, the Creator , and Doja Cat . The rest of the lineup included acts such as Blur, Peso Pluma, Lil Uzi Vert, Ice Spice, J Balvin, and Grimes. Video

The first weekend of next year’s Coachella is set for Friday, April 10, through Sunday, April 12. The second weekend will take place from Friday, April 17, through, Sunday, April 19. As always, Coachella takes place at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. Lady Gaga , Green Day , Travis Scott , and Post Malone headlined Coachella 2025. results.title: Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival 2027 - FabFestivals
excerpts:
Coachella organisers have officially announced the dates for the 2027 edition of the festival, which will take place across two weekends: April 9–11 and April 16–18, 2027, at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. No artists or headliners have been confirmed yet. Coachella is an annual rock festival held at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, featuring music on multiple stages. The Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival began in October 1999 as a two-day event. Beck and Rage Against the Machine headlined, and more than 25,000 people attended. It was held just months after the disastrous Woodstock '99, and it was unclear if promoters could turn a profit on a weekend-long multi-stage event. Site logo

results.title: Coachella, Influential Music Festival, Is Postponed Amid Virus Fears - The New York Times
excerpts:
Share full article At the Coachella festival last year. Credit... Rich Fury/Getty Images for Coachella By Ben Sisario Published March 10, 2020 Updated March 13, 2020 Coachella is postponed. Organizers of the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival, the giant pop festival in the picturesque desert of Southern California, have delayed next month’s event to October over concerns about the coronavirus, the festival announced on Tuesday after days of speculation. The festival, which had been planned in two weekend installments, April 10 to 12 and April 17 to 19, will now take place six months later, from Oct. 9 to 11 and Oct. 16 to 18. In a brief statement, the festival made no comment about the lineup. Related Content
